gizmo.title: Chaartii raadaraa
gizmo.description: Chaartii raadaraa (sardiidaa) moodeela bilchina fi qabxii amaloota, kan akka HEOSAT. Barreeffama bakka bu'aa fi gabatee daataa of keessaa qaba.

configure.title: Mata-duree
configure.description: Mata-duree chaartii; akka maqaa isaa dhaqqabamaattis fayyada.

configure.title: Ramaddiiwwan
configure.description: Sarara tokkotti ramaddii tokko. Yoo xiqqaate 3 barbaachisa.

configure.title: Qabxiiwwan
configure.description: Lakkoofsota qooddiidhaan gargar ba'an, ramaddii tokkoof tokko tartiiba walfakkaatuun.

configure.title: Qabxii galmaa
configure.description: Lakkoofsota qooddiidhaan gargar ba'an, ramaddii tokkoof tokko tartiiba walfakkaatuun.

configure.title: Ibsa mallattoolee agarsiisi
configure.description: Ibsa mallattoolee qabxiiwwanii fi galmoota maqaa dhahu agarsiisi.

configure.title: Xiqqaa
configure.description: Chaartii xiqqaa maqaa, ibsa mallattoolee ykn gabatee daataa hin qabne. Gatii isaa arguuf qabxii irra maawusii kaa'i.

advanced.title: Maqaa qabxii
advanced.description: Maqaa ibsa mallattoolee fi gabatee qabxiiwwaniif.

advanced.title: Maqaa galmaa
advanced.description: Maqaa ibsa mallattoolee fi gabatee galmootaaf.
